briefs.title: Tualatin Valley water bills among the steepest increases in the country over a decade
briefs.dek: Plus Winter Lights in Beaverton City Park through early January, where to cut a Christmas tree, Glencoe's Columbia Cup win, and a busy Dec. 1 for the city council and county board.

briefs.title: Wrong-way crash on Sunset Highway kills one early Thanksgiving morning
briefs.dek: Plus the county board's Tuesday agenda (a $1.2 million match to replace the 170th Avenue bridge over Beaverton Creek, a Sherwood land sale), Beaverton's hotel-tax vote, a menorah lighting in City Park, and up to 2½ inches of rain by Saturday morning.

briefs.title: Beaverton police arrest 19 in holiday retail theft sweep
briefs.dek: Plus staff's recommendation on the Canyon Road car-storage appeal, a vote on doubling the hotel tax, a soggy Thanksgiving, and a Banks-Vernonia Trail closure.
